headlines.title_en: Manhattan rents hit record high as some shell out $4,000 just to view 'hidden listings'
headlines.summary_en: Manhattan rents surged to a record high in July, with available rental inventory contracting historically, coinciding with the summer leasing peak and worsening the supply-demand imbalance. According to the latest data from real estate appraisal firm Miller Samuel Inc. and The Real Deal, the median rent for newly signed leases in July reached $5,000, up 6.4% year-over-year—double the national housing cost increase. U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics data shows national housing prices rose 3.2% year-over-year. Amid the sharp rent surge, inventory fell dramatically. Last month, Manhattan listed rental units plunged over 39% year-over-year, a decline rarely seen in the past decade. The trend has also spread across the East River, with Brooklyn's median rent hitting a record high of $4,500 in July, while listed inventory...

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title_en: China's market appeal rises as foreign consumer giants see business rebound in China
headlines.summary_en: Recently, foreign consumer giants including Coca-Cola, L'Oreal, and Procter & Gamble have released second-quarter or first-half 2026 earnings. The Chinese market has broadly emerged as a growth engine, with many multinationals seeing a turning point in their China performance. Reporting found that this recovery results from multiple factors converging, including shifting consumer trends, policy dividend releases, and companies' own strategic adjustments. Facing increasingly rational and diverse Chinese consumers, leaders across consumer sub-sectors are accelerating optimization of brand portfolios and channel layouts, demonstrating confidence in continued deep engagement with the Chinese market. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.summary: 近日，恒生科技指数启动了推出以来力度最大的一次改革。根据恒生指数公司发布的咨询文件，此次改革重点包括指数成分股由30只增至50只、扩大指数的科技主题范围、采取“市值、收入增速”双轨制选股机制等。在业内人士看来，指数的生命力在于紧跟市场趋势变化。恒生科技指数此次修订编制规则，契合外资配置中国科技资产的需求，有助于持续吸引境外资金流向中国硬科技产业。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Hang Seng Tech Index undergoes major overhaul to boost foreign allocation in Chinese tech assets
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the Hang Seng Tech Index launched its most significant reform since inception. According to a consultation paper from Hang Seng Indexes Company, key changes include expanding constituents from 30 to 50 stocks, broadening the index's tech theme scope, and adopting a dual-track stock selection mechanism based on 'market cap and revenue growth.' Industry insiders believe an index's vitality lies in tracking market trends. This revision to the Hang Seng Tech Index's methodology aligns with foreign investors' demand for allocating to China's tech assets and should help sustain overseas capital flows into China's hard-tech sector. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title_en: Nearly 100 firms complete private placements this year, raising over 169 billion yuan in total
headlines.summary_en: Since the start of this year, the A-share market has continued to recover, and activity in the private placement market has risen significantly. Wind data shows that, based on issue dates, 98 A-share companies have completed share placements this year, up 28.95% from 76 in the same period last year, raising a total of RMB 169.286 billion. Excluding four banks' placements for working capital replenishment last year, that's a 54.13% increase year-over-year. As of the August 13 close, 64 companies' latest share prices (adjusted) exceeded their placement prices, with the highest gain near 280%. The remaining 34 companies saw prices temporarily fall below placement issue prices, accounting for about 35%. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 中国人民银行今日开展10000亿元6个月期买断式逆回购操作
headlines.summary: 【中国人民银行今日开展10000亿元6个月期买断式逆回购操作】8月13日，中国人民银行发布公开市场买断式逆回购招标公告。公告显示，为保持银行体系流动性充裕，2026年8月14日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展10000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为6个月（185天），到期日为2027年2月15日（遇节假日顺延）。

headlines.title_en: PBOC conducts 1 trillion yuan 6-month outright reverse repo operation today
headlines.summary_en: [PBOC Conducts RMB 1 Trillion 6-Month Outright Reverse Repo Operation Today] On August 13, the People's Bank of China issued a tender announcement for open market outright reverse repos. The announcement states that, to maintain ample banking system liquidity, on August 14, 2026, the PBOC will conduct a RMB 1 trillion outright reverse repo operation with fixed quantity, interest rate bidding, and multiple-price award, with a 6-month (185-day) term and maturity on February 15, 2027 (postponed if holiday).

headlines.summary: 近期，可口可乐、欧莱雅、宝洁等外资消费龙头企业相继发布2026年第二季度或上半年财报。中国市场普遍成为增长引擎，多家跨国企业在华业绩迎来拐点。记者采访获悉，此轮复苏是消费趋势变化、政策红利释放与企业自身战略调整等多重因素共振的结果。面对中国消费者日趋理性、多元的需求，消费细分赛道的各大龙头正加速优化品牌矩阵与渠道布局，并展现出持续深耕中国市场的信心。（上证报）
